# low down to the line 1934 (the 1931 total 11.120.000 = 120.000 printed on the 1932 line + 11.000.000; footnote
# (1) "en 1931" is attached to the 50 printed on the 1932 line; the values printed on the lines 1926-1931
# equal sgt1930's 1925-1930). The script stores them one year earlier (row_realigned), through the line 1934;
# the line 1935 is taken as printed (see notes). Cours moyens: livres sterling to 1930, francs from 1931;
# (2) cours moyen de la £ = 89 fr. 14.
